name_zh: 哈萨克·阿拜·库南巴耶夫：草原哲学家与教育启蒙
name_en: Kazakh Abai Kunanbayev: Steppe Philosopher & Education Enlightenment
description_zh: 阿拜·库南巴耶夫 (1845-1904) 哈萨克伟大诗人、哲学家、教育家，创作《劝诫集》融合伊斯兰、儒家、俄国启蒙思想，推动哈萨克语言标准化、世俗教育普及，被誉为哈萨克民族精神之父。
description_en: Abai Kunanbayev (1845-1904) Kazakh great poet, philosopher, educator, authored Book of Words fusing Islamic, Confucian, Russian Enlightenment thought, promoted Kazakh language standardization, secular education popularization, hailed as father of Kazakh national spirit.
reason_zh: 阿拜代表草原文明向现代性转型的思想先驱，展示了游牧民族如何通过哲学反思与教育改革实现文化自觉与现代化转型，是中亚启蒙运动的灯塔。
reason_en: Abai represents steppe civilization transition to modernity intellectual pioneer, demonstrating how nomadic people achieve cultural self-awareness and modernization through philosophical reflection and education reform, a beacon of Central Asian Enlightenment.
steps_zh: 研究阿拜早年伊斯兰教育与俄国流亡接触启蒙思想
分析《劝诫集》融合伊斯兰儒家俄国启蒙三大传统
探讨阿拜推动哈萨克语标准化与阿拉伯字母改良
评估阿拜创办俄哈萨克语学校与世俗教育实践
总结阿拜思想对苏联时期哈萨克文化复兴与独立后民族建构的影响
steps_en: Study Abai early Islamic education and Russian exile contact with Enlightenment
Analyze Book of Words fusing Islamic Confucian Russian Enlightenment three traditions
Explore Abai promoting Kazakh language standardization and Arabic script reform
Evaluate Abai founding Russian-Kazakh schools and secular education practice
Summarize Abai thought impact on Soviet Kazakh cultural revival and post-independence nation-building
expected_zh: 掌握阿拜跨文明哲学融合与教育启蒙双重使命，理解游牧文明现代化转型的思想路径，评估其对哈萨克民族精神重塑的奠基作用。
expected_en: Master Abai cross-civilizational philosophical fusion and educational enlightenment dual mission, understand nomadic civilization modernization intellectual path, evaluate its foundational role in Kazakh national spirit reshaping.
case_zh: 1845 阿拜生于塞米巴拉金斯克；1880s 创作《劝诫集》；1904 逝世；1995 哈萨克斯坦设立阿拜纪念日。草原哲学家教育启蒙永存。
case_en: 1845 Abai born in Semipalatinsk; 1880s authored Book of Words; 1904 death; 1995 Kazakhstan established Abai Memorial Day. Steppe philosopher education enlightenment endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Kazakh language standardization; secular education; cross-civilizational synthesis
artistic_legacy: 是: 古典哈萨克诗歌/哲学散文
